name: Kamrat
publication: Dungeons & Doggos: Dig in the Dirt with a Dwarf's Best Friends
appearance: A small smooth-coated tunnel dog with a long body, triangular ears, strong short legs, and oversized front paws.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.effectNote: One target takes 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage on a hit.

Reactions.name: Reflexive Escape
Reactions.effectNote: When attacked by a creature it can see, the kamrat can move up to 5 ft. The attack misses if that puts it out of reach.

Variant options.name: Variant selection
Variant options.effectNote: Choose at most one option. It replaces Reflexive Escape.

Variant options.name: Dedicated Target (bonus action)
Variant options.effectNote: Choose one creature the kamrat can see. It has advantage on attacks against that creature and on ability checks to track or follow it while it can see the target and for 3 hours after losing sight of it.

Variant options.name: Frenetic (bonus action)
Variant options.effectNote: The kamrat takes the Disengage or Hide action.

Variant options.name: Digger (trait)
Variant options.effectNote: This variant has a 5-ft. burrowing speed.

notes: Printed Perception 12, Stealth 15. Ability modifiers are Str −1, Dex +5, Con +2, Int −4, Wis +2, Cha −1.
The ordinary kamrat has only the printed 30-ft. walking speed. The source classifies its echo sensing as blindsense.

name: Olhund
publication: Dungeons & Doggos: Dig in the Dirt with a Dwarf's Best Friends
appearance: A heavy, muscular hound with brindled fur, floppy ears, and loose skin around its jowls.

Traits.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
Traits.effectNote: Perception is 16 for hearing or smell.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.effectNote: The olhund makes one Smashing Paw attack and one Bite attack.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.effectNote: One target takes 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage on a hit.

Actions.name: Smashing Paw
Actions.effectNote: One target takes 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage on a hit. A creature no more than one size larger falls prone on a failed save. The olhund can choose to knock a creature unconscious instead of killing it.

Bonus Actions.name: Intimidating Rumble
Bonus Actions.effectNote: One creature the olhund can see within 30 ft. is frightened of it for 1 minute on a failed save. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

Variant options.name: Variant selection
Variant options.effectNote: Choose at most one option. The GM removes either Smashing Paw or Intimidating Rumble.

Variant options.name: Den Tactics (trait)
Variant options.effectNote: The olhund has advantage on attacks and ability checks in its den. It can choose or be trained to accept a new den with the Creature Training downtime activity from Player’s Guide 2.

Variant options.name: Grappling Charge (trait)
Variant options.effectNote: If the olhund moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits with Bite or Smashing Paw on the same turn, the target falls prone and is grappled on a failed save (escape DC 14). It can grapple one target at a time.

Variant options.name: Protective Strike (reaction)
Variant options.effectNote: When a target the olhund can see is hit by an attack from a creature within 5 ft. of it, the olhund can make one Bite attack against the attacker.

notes: Printed Perception 11, Stealth 16. Ability modifiers are Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Int −3, Wis +1, Cha −2.
The article describes the hounds as moving slowly in everyday life. The printed combat speed is 60 ft.
The source gives no replacement Multiattack when the GM removes Smashing Paw.
Protective Strike leaves the reference point for its 5-ft. distance implicit.

name: Storgin
publication: Dungeons & Doggos: Loyal Dogs of the Halflings and Gnomes
appearance: A short-legged, wiry-coated hound with a deep chest, thick neck, and short, powerful muzzle.

Traits.name: Beast of Burden
Traits.effectNote: Treat the storgin as Large when calculating carrying capacity.

Traits.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
Traits.effectNote: Perception is 18 for hearing or smell.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.effectNote: While in sunlight, the storgin has disadvantage on attack rolls and its Perception is 8 for sight.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.effectNote: One target takes 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage on a hit. A Medium or smaller creature is grappled on a hit (escape DC 12). The storgin cannot bite another target until this grapple ends.

Reactions.name: Crushing Jaws
Reactions.effectNote: When a creature it is grappling hits it, the storgin can squeeze its jaws to deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage to that creature.

notes: Printed Perception 13, Stealth 12. Ability modifiers are Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int −4, Wis +1, Cha −2.
Gnomish handlers train storgins to carry packs and haul wagons. The stone-eating story is a legend.

name: Pennig
publication: Dungeons & Doggos: Loyal Dogs of the Halflings and Gnomes
appearance: A tall, long-legged riding dog with a dense double coat, a rough muzzle, and a curled or plumed tail.

Traits.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
Traits.effectNote: Perception is 16 for hearing or smell.

Traits.name: Pack Tactics
Traits.effectNote: The pennig has advantage on an attack against a creature if an ally is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not incapacitated.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.effectNote: One target takes 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage on a hit. A creature falls prone on a failed save.

Reactions.name: Trained Shift
Reactions.effectNote: When an effect would knock the rider prone or dismount the rider, the pennig can give the rider advantage on the check or save to avoid it.

notes: Printed Perception 11, Stealth 12. Ability modifiers are Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Int −3, Wis +1, Cha −2.
Pennigs are trained to carry and protect riders. Scale mail barding changes the printed AC from 12 to 15.
